text:
ryan: Heads-up: a small but noticeable uptick in fncall validator rejects in sa-east-1 canary. Reject sample:
```
{
  \"error\": \"unparseable\",
  \"detail\": \"expected object at top-level for tool call, got string\"
}
```
Looks like some SDKs sending serialized JSON as a string. tagging @emma @priya

emma: Thanks. Which validator version is this? Also, do we have route attribution when these rejects happen early? We lose route_id/account_id which makes triage painful.

ops-bot: Canary status: feature=fncall-validate-coerce, region=sa-east-1, rollout_pct=4, status=running

priya: Two immediate mitigation options: 1) SOFT-FAIL so requests pass through and we log `validator_orig_error`; 2) COERCE mode where we attempt `string->json` and `null->[]` heuristics and add `mediation_applied=true`. COERCE seems nicer UX but is riskier.

ryan: If we COERCE, we must preserve quota attribution. Right now coerced requests go to fallback route which skews billing. We need a flag `preserve_route=true` emitted on mediation events.

emma: Telemetry needs: standardized error codes (UNPARSEABLE, EXTRA_FIELDS, TYPE_MISMATCH, MISSING_REQUIRED), fields `route_id`, `account_id`, `validator_version`, and `mediation_kind` when applied. Also capture `validator_mode` (STRICT/COERCE/SOFTFAIL) in events.

priya: UX question: when we COERCE and change shape, do we surface that in the console with a redacted diff? I vote yes: show redacted before/after and let customers opt-in to auto-coerce per-key. Default OFF.

ryan: Alerting: page eng-oncall if reject_rate > 0.5% OR mediation_applied_rate > 0.3% in a region for 10m. Dashboard: \"fncall: rejects vs mediation by account\" + top 20 offending routes.

emma: I'll add telemetry PR and alert rules (PR: https://git.internal/repo/telemetry/PR-999). We'll also add sampling for full redacted payloads at 2% for mediated events.

priya: For rollout: enable COERCE in canary at 1% (sa-east-1) as experiment, but start with SUGGEST mode (reject + suggestion) at 5% to collect data. If safe, escalate COERCE to 1% and monitor. Add rollback steps.

ops-bot: Update: feature=fncall-validate-coerce mode=SUGGEST, rollout_pct=5 in sa-east-1. Change recorded at 2024-09-03T08:15:00Z

ryan: Agreed. Create INF-5233 for per-account auto-coerce toggle + console UX mock. Priya please attach sample redacted diffs.

priya: INF-5233 created and linked to telemetry PR. Will upload 10 redacted sample diffs.

emma: Will include enum mapping and event spec in PR. Also adding retention note: keep full redacted samples for 30 days.

ryan: Nice. Closing thread; tracking in INF-5233 and PR-999. :thumbsup:
